section.title: Examples of Accessing the API
section.p: See Authenticate page to acquire a token.

sectiondiv.p: The following example shows how to use curl to Reprocess a failed order (retry payment and fulfillment).
The following example shows how to use Python to Reprocess a failed order (retry payment and fulfillment).
sectiondiv.codeblock: import requests headers = { "Authorization": "<auth-token>" } url = "https://" + SERVER_URL + "/api/v1/orders/{orderId}" resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers)
